senses.gloss: वृष- + उत्सर्ग वृष- + उत्सर्ग, m. setting a bull at liberty on occasion of a sacrifice or obsequial oblation, Pañc. 9, 3.
वृषभैकादश वृषभैकादश, i. e. वृषभ-, adj., f. शा, having a bull as the eleventh, i. e. ten (cows) with a bull, Man. 11, 116 (117).
वृष-दंश् + अ वृष-दंश् + अ, m. a cat.
वृषभ- + ध्वज वृषभ- + ध्वज, m. a name of Śiva, Chr. 48, 11.
† वृश् वृश्, i. 4, Par. To choose, to select (cf. वृ).

वृष् वृष् (probably वि-ऋष्, q. cf.), i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 1, 5464),
 1. To rain, Rām. 1, 9, 56.
 2. To shed, MBh. 1, 1419.
 3. To moisten, Dev. 3, 2.
 4. † To hurt.
 5. † To weary.
 6. † To give.
 7. † To engender.
 8. † To have supreme power.
 --Ptcple. of the pres. वर्षन्त्, Rain, Man. 4, 38.
 --Comp. ptcple. pf. pass. अ-वृष्ट, adj. Not having rained, Pañc. 51, 16.
 --Caus. To induce to rain, MBh. 3, 9991.
 --i. 10, Ātm. †
 1. To be possessed of generative power.
 2. To be powerful.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि,
 1. To shower on, Rām. 2, 67, 8; Vikr. 54, 6.
 2. To rain, MBh. 1, 4062; figuratively, Man. 9, 304. अभिवृष्ट, Rained on, extinguished by rain, Vikr. d. 125.
 --With निस् निस्, निर्वृष्ट, Having done raining, [] Ragh. 4, 15 (Calc.).
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To begin to rain, Pañc. 169, 7.
 2. To rain, Naiṣ. 22, 41. प्रवृष्त, One who has caused to rain, Utt. Rāmac. 158, 6.
 --With अभिप्र अभि-प्र, To rain fast, Man. 9, 304.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To assail, Chr. 34, 15.
 --With वि वि, To deluge with rain.
 --Cf. ἀπο-έρσει, etc.; ἕρση; akin is βρέχω.

वृश्चिक वृश्चिक (vb. व्रश्च्), m.
 1. A scorpion, Bhāg. P. 3, 30, 27.
 2. The sign Scorpio.
 3. A caterpillar.
 4. A crab.
 5. A centipede.
 6. A sort of beetle.
 --Comp.

वृष वृष् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. A bull, Hit. 58, 16.
 2. The sign Taurus.
 3. A rat (as in वृष-दंशक, m. A cat, Sāh. D. 303, 6).
 4. As latter part of comp. nouns, Excellent, pre-eminent.
 II. f. षी, The seat of the religious student, made of Kuśa grass (cf. Rām. 3, 49, 23). MBh. 13, 462.
 III. n. A peacock's tail.
 --Comp.
वृषक वृष + क, m. A proper name.
वृषखादि वृषखादि, i. e. वृषन्-खादि, adj. Adorned or endowed with rain, Chr. 290, 10 = Rigv. i. 64, 10.

वृषण वृषण, i. e. वृष् + अन, m. The testicles or scrotum, Man. 8, 283; Pañc. 10, 12.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. as akin, ὄρχις.

वृषध्वज वृष-ध्वज,
 I. adj. Having as emblem a bull.
 II. m. Śiva, Johns. Sel. 89, 25; Kir. 13, 28.

वृषन् वृष् + अन्, m.
 I. adj. Raining, Chr. 290, 1 = Rigv. i. 64, 1.
 II. m.
 1. The dropping beverage, called Soma, Chr. 291, 7 = Rigv. i. 85, 7.
 2. A bull.
 3. A horse.
 4. A name of Indra, Ragh. 10, 53.
 5. Karṇa.

वृषभ वृष-भ (vb. भा),
 I. m.
 1. A bull, Hit. i. d. 135, M.M. (दुष्ट-, A malicious bull).
 2. The orifice of the ear.
 3. An elephant's ear.
 4. As latter part of comp. words, Preeminent, excellent.
 II. f. भी, A widow.
 --Comp.
वृषय वृषय, m. Refuge, shelter.

वृषल वृषल (from वृष्),
 I. m.
 1. A horse.
 2. A Śūdra, Utt. Rāmac. 40, 1, cf. 4.
 3. A man of the three first classes who, by neglecting his religious duties, has lost his caste.
 4. A sinner, Lass. Pentap. p. 70, v. 73.
 5. Garlic.
 II. f. ली.
 1. A Śūdra woman, Man. 3, 19; Pañc. iii. d. 218 (but cf. Kāśīkh. 40, 93).
 2. A woman during menstruation.
 3. A barren woman.
वृषलक वृषल + क, m. A poor Śūdra, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 4.
वृषस्य वृषस्य, a denomin. derived from वृष with स्य, Par. To be warm, to long for sexual intercourse, Ragh. 12, 34.

वृषाकपि वृषाकपि (probably वृषन्-कपि),
 I. m.
 1. Viṣṇu.
 2. Śiva.
 3. Agni.
 II. f. पायी.
 1. Lakṣmī.
 2. Gaurī.
 3. Swāhā, the wife of Agni.
 4. Śaci, the wife of Indra.

वृष्टि वृष्टि, i. e. वृष् + ति, f. Rain, Vikr. d. 154.
 --Comp.

वृष्णि वृष्णि, i. e. वृष् + नि,
 I. adj.
 1. Passionate, angry.
 2. Heretical.
 II. m.
 1. A ram.
 2. Indra.
 3. Agni.
 4. Viṣṇu.
 5. One of the descendants of Yadu, Bhag. 10, 37.
 6. The name of a class of Kṣatriyas and Vaiśyas, [] Pañc. iii. d. 268.
 7. Air, wind.
 8. A ray of light.
 --Cf. ἀρν in ἀρνός, ἀρνειός, ῥήν, ἕρσαι, ἔριϕος.
वृषव्रात वृषव्रात, i. e. वृषन्-, adj. abounding in drops of rain, Chr. 291, 4 = Rigv. i. 85, 4.
वृषभ- + षोडश वृषभ- + षोडश (having a bull as sixteenth, i. e.) fifteen cows and a bull, Man. 9, 124, v. r. (cf. Lois.).
वृष्टि- + संपात वृष्टि- + संपात, m. a shower of rain, Rājat. 5, 275.
वृष- + स्कन्ध वृष- + स्कन्ध, adj. having the shoulders of a bull, Rām. 3, 55, 4.
